title: Hawaiian-Style Jamaican Beef Hash
description: A unique fusion of Jamaican and Hawaiian flavors, this dish features tender feather blade beef, smoky spices, and a hint of tropical sweetness.
instructions: Season the beef with tandoor spice blend, salt, and allspice.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the toasted coconut flakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the pineapple chunks, coconut milk, and chopped cilantro.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the beef is coated in the flavorful sauce.
Serve the beef hash hot, garnished with additional toasted coconut flakes if desired.
